notes:
Workshop summary and raw notes:
- Primary workload: customer-facing chat + server-side reranking for fraud scoring.
- Baseline steady-state: 30 QPS for chat (avg req = 220 tokens generation), 10 QPS rerank (avg 6 candidates, short outputs).
- Derived baseline tokens/sec: chat ~ 30 * 220 = 6,600 tok/s; rerank stream negligible but causes concurrency spikes.
- Peak profile observed in logs: intermittent bursts up to 180 QPS for 90-120s during batch jobs and marketing events.
- Latency SLO targets: p95 < 450ms for short-turn interactions; p95 < 1200ms for long-form responses. Absolute max p99 target 2s.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high; willing to reserve committed capacity to guarantee throughput but wants clear unit economics vs hosted.
- Model preferences: prefer open Llama3-style weights, evaluated on H100 runtime; fallbacks to smaller quantized variants for off-peak saving.
- Routing/fallback: require automatic fallback to quantized 8-bit variant if node unavailable; warm KV cache across instances.
- Security: full VPC private deployment, SAML SSO, AES KMS with customer-managed keys, audit logs for all tokenized payloads. Data residency: primary EU+NA; must ensure routing per region.
- Sizing notes from workshop: prototype run on A100-80GB: 1x A100 can handle ~18 steady QPS for their average prompt size at p95 ~700ms using single-model serving; recommends starting reservation of 6x H100-80GB equiv to cover steady with headroom + capacity for peaks via burst pool.
- Suggested reserved config: 6 reserved H100-equivalent GPUs + 2 on-demand burst nodes; autoscale policy target 70% utilization; preemption window and warm-start policy to avoid latency spikes.
- SLA negotiation points to surface in procurement: guaranteed reserved throughput (min 25 QPS per region), latency SLO credits if p95 exceeds thresholds for >5 minutes, defined failover playbook and RTO for node loss, extra audit retention option (+90 days).
- Open items: final traffic generator scenario for 180 QPS burst test, legal wants explicit credit calculation, security needs SOC2 artifact and penetration test statement.
- Quote request: committed monthly capacity vs blended per-token pricing for burst usage.
- Customer quote ask: 12 month term with 10% discount on on-demand bursts, clear exit/backfill path.
- Sales notes: customer repeatedly asked 'can you guarantee p95 < 500ms during promo spikes?' - need ops runbook to prove.
